answer: Route every identity through River, a settlement contract escrowing one rate-priced bond per agent: bond = k x message rate. No open bond means the identity is dropped before its first message; a failed audit burns the bond. Each puppet pays its own bond, so N attackers pay N times, no batch discount, marginal cost linear in n. The bond drains the attacker wallet, an on-chain decrement they cannot reset or clone, so new identities re-fund from one source. The quartz clock oracle seals each bond event into a signal auditors verify atomically, slashing loop identities.
